process FINALETOOLKIT_AGGBW {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_low'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/34/34f01d128ed135aedc33ddb62fced3911bef6d1a909694291b7184bf83719402/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/finaletoolkit:0.11.1--8fe5ba6ec9e2ec95'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(bigwig)
    tuple val(meta2), path(intervals)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.wig"), emit: wig
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('finaletoolkit'), eval("finaletoolkit --version | sed 's/FinaleToolkit //g'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_finaletoolkit

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}_agg"
    """
    export MPLCONFIGDIR=.

    finaletoolkit \\
        agg-bw \\
        ${bigwig} \\
        ${intervals} \\
        ${args} \\
        -o "${prefix}.wig"
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}_agg"
    """
    echo ${args}

    touch "${prefix}.wig"
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/finaletoolkit/aggbw"
description: "Aggregates a bigWig signal over constant-length intervals\ndefined in\
  \ a BED file.\n"
keywords:
- "genomics"
- "aggregation"
- "fragmentomics"
tools:
- finaletoolkit:
    description: "Extract cfDNA fragmentation features from sequencing data."
    homepage: "https://epifluidlab.github.io/FinaleToolkit/"
    documentation: "https://epifluidlab.github.io/FinaleToolkit/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/epifluidlab/FinaleToolkit"
    doi: "10.1093/bioadv/vbaf236"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:finaletoolkit"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - bigwig:
      type: "file"
      description: "BigWig file containing signals to aggregate"
      pattern: "*.bw"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3006"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - intervals:
      type: "file"
      pattern: "*.bed"
      description: "BED file containing intervals to aggregate for\n"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3003"
output:
  wig:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}.wig:
        type: "file"
        pattern: "*.wig"
        description: "Wiggle file containing aggregated scores over the itnervals\n"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3005"
  versions_finaletoolkit:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - finaletoolkit:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - finaletoolkit --version | sed 's/FinaleToolkit //g':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - finaletoolkit:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - finaletoolkit --version | sed 's/FinaleToolkit //g':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@lbeltrame"
maintainers:
- "@lbeltrame"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
